title: An Empirical Investigation of Pre-Trained Deep Learning Model Reuse in the Scientific Process
abstract: arXiv:2603.13584v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning has achieved recognition for its impact within natural sciences, yet the prohibitive financial and technical cost of training models from scratch inhibit adoption. Following software engineering community guidance, natural scientists are reusing pre-trained deep learning models (PTMs) to amortize these costs. While prior works recommend PTM reuse patterns, we present the first empirical study of PTM reuse patterns in the natural sciences, quantifying the utilization and impact of PTM reuse within the scientific process across 17,718 peer reviewed, open access papers. Our results show that "Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology" has outpaced other natural scientific fields in PTM reuse, "adaptation" reuse is the most prevalent PTM reuse pattern identified across all natural science fields, and the "testing" stage of the scientific process has been most impacted by PTM integration.

translated_title: 科学过程中预训练深度学习模型复用的实证研究
translated_abstract: 深度学习因其在自然科学领域的影响力而获得广泛认可，然而从头训练模型所需的巨额财务和技术成本阻碍了其普及应用。遵循软件工程社区的指导，自然科学家正在复用预训练深度学习模型（PTMs）来分摊这些成本。尽管先前的工作已推荐了PTM复用模式，但本研究首次对自然科学领域的PTM复用模式进行了实证研究，通过分析17,718篇经同行评审的开放获取论文，量化了PTM复用在科学过程中的利用率和影响。结果表明，“生物化学、遗传学与分子生物学”领域在PTM复用方面已超越其他自然科学领域，“适配”复用是所有自然科学领域中最普遍的PTM复用模式，而科学过程中的“测试”阶段受PTM整合的影响最大。
tldr: 该研究首次对自然科学领域的预训练深度学习模型复用模式进行大规模实证分析，通过17,718篇论文发现生物化学等领域复用最多、“适配”复用模式最普遍、科学过程中的“测试”阶段受影响最大。
